title: BBCincorp
description: Performance Optimization: Achieve High Performance for 100% Pages with the Pagespeed Insight Tool. Build a company formation website with 400 pages using Nextjs and TailwindCSS
Technology Used : NextJS, Atomic Design, React Bootstrap

content.title: Project Information
content.description: 🏢 Project Name: BBCIncorp - Global Business Formation Platform
list: Tech Stack: Next.js, TailwindCSS, AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, CloudFront, CodeBuild), Headless WordPress

content.title: 1. The Challenge
content.description: The old system (SlugJS) was heavy with low performance scores (<40) affecting SEO. Particularly, when transitioning to Static Site architecture (S3 Hosting) to increase speed, the team faced a major challenge: Static websites on S3 cannot handle server-side logic such as complex 301/302 redirects or dynamic headers processing that the old system was doing.

content.title: 2. The Solution & Architecture
content.description: I designed a Hybrid Cloud architecture combining the speed of Static Sites with the flexibility of Serverless:

content.title: 2.1. Frontend Modernization
content.description: Migrated to Next.js + TailwindCSS with Atomic Design, increasing code reusability and maintainability.

content.title: 2.2. Serverless Logic (AWS Lambda)
list: Deployed AWS Lambda to handle server-side tasks that S3 cannot perform.
Processed routing logic (Dynamic Redirects) to maintain SEO rankings when changing URL structure.
Customized HTTP responses (Headers manipulation) to enhance security and caching.

content.title: 2.3. Infrastructure & Security
list: Static Delivery: Build static files via CodeBuild -> push to S3 -> distribute through CloudFront (CDN) with load time <1s.
Private CMS: Deployed WordPress on EC2 in Private Subnet. Used NAT Gateway to block public access, only allowing Build Server to access data through network security layer (VPC Security Groups).

content.title: 3. Key Achievements
list: 🏆 Maximum Performance: Achieved perfect 100/100 PageSpeed Insights score (from previous 40).
🧠 Smart Routing: Completely solved static website routing issues using Lambda, ensuring SEO traffic preservation during migration.
🛡️ Enterprise Security: CMS system is absolutely protected, with zero attack surface from Internet (Zero public exposure).
👨‍💻 Leadership: Proposed technology, mentored team members and built standard CI/CD processes.
